title: Unchecked Return Value or Missing Balance Verification in `Flopper.deal` Minting Logic
impact: `Flopper.deal` calls `gem.mint(bids[id].guy, bids[id].lot)` to distribute minted debt-auction tokens to the winning bidder. If the underlying `GemLike` token implementation does not revert on failure (e.g., non-standard ERC-20s or custom minters returning `false` instead of reverting), auctions can be finalized without the winner receiving tokens while their initial bid collateral remains locked or unaccounted for.
